I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM.

1. #4419: gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing. Source: "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)", teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md.
2. #PD-4492: Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard weren't getting SMS bay assignments when checking in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct. The note also says to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window. Source: "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth", teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md.

Two other Moss notes mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers: the 14 Sep 2025 North pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in.

There's one more ticket, but it isn't from Moss. The Quarrendon account page (last updated 30 Sep 2026) lists #4912 as open with support, for lag on the Gate_Dwell_Daily report at Bay 14 check-ins in the Superior yard. I left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" because that's a different company and not a customer.
